posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina's team denies acting comeback rumors, calling them 'baseless speculation.' Reports had claimed she was eyeing OTT projects for a 2027 return after embracing motherhood.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit's partition drama Main Vaapas Aaunga with Imtiaz Ali and AR Rahman hit theaters on June 12. The film received praise from Adivi Sesh and Anurag Kashyap despite a crowded box office weekend.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Alpha teaser clocked 75M+ views in 24 hours as Alia transforms into a deadly assassin for the first female-led YRF Spy Universe film. Releasing July 3 with Bobby Deol and Sharvari.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka ranked #3 on Fortune India's Most Valuable Celebrities 2026 — the only woman on a standalone cover. Currently shooting Rajamouli's Varanasi with Mahesh Babu for April 2027.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: King confirmed for Christmas 2026 (Dec 24) release with Siddharth Anand directing. SRK plays an assassin alongside daughter Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, and Deepika Padukone in a ₹350 crore spectacle.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is gearing up for Daayra, a gritty thriller directed by Meghna Gulzar (Raazi fame) alongside Malayalam superstar Prithviraj Sukumaran. A bold content-driven reinvention for Bebo.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha's biographical drama Eetha locks August 28 release — she plays legendary Marathi folk performer Vithabai Narayangaonkar. Also in talks for Mahavatar opposite Vicky Kaushal.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh, with celebs flooding the comments. She's also back on the sets of King with Shah Rukh Khan after her first maternity break.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar 2 shattered OTT records with 70M+ views on JioHotstar, becoming the most-watched Indian film digitally. Its TV premiere delivered the highest reach in five years.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya continues to be one of India's most iconic global faces. The former Miss World remains selectively active, with fans eagerly awaiting her next big-screen project announcement.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika's action-thriller Mysa completed its fifth shooting schedule with a teaser coming soon. She continues her unstoppable streak as one of India's most searched actresses on Google.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's Maa Inti Bangaaram hits theaters June 19 — her debut as producer. The family action drama features her doing intense stunts in a saree, reuniting with Oh! Baby director Nandini Reddy.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun praised brother Ram Charan's Peddi as 'mind-blowing' and 'genuinely proud.' His next film Raaka with director Atlee is expected for summer 2027 with Janhvi Kapoor.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Peddi crossed ₹185 Cr India net and $3M in North America, becoming Ram Charan's biggest solo hit. Makers are reportedly planning a major re-edit to boost second-weekend momentum.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR is in talks with Hi Nanna director Shouryuv for a 2-part action drama and set to reunite with director Trivikram. His upcoming Dragon film continues to build massive anticipation.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi earned her biggest paycheck of ₹8 crore for Peddi alongside Ram Charan, a 50% jump from Devara. Next up: Raaka with Allu Arjun and Lag Ja Gale with Tiger Shroff.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya's romantic drama Chand Mera Dil with Lakshya, directed by Karan Johar, is generating early buzz. She was among the first celebs to congratulate Deepika and Ranveer on baby #2.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara and Sidharth Malhotra welcomed baby girl Saraayah, stepping into parenthood after their dreamy Jaisalmer wedding. She was last seen in War 2 with Hrithik Roshan and Jr NTR.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik signed with Hollywood powerhouse Anonymous Content for global representation, signaling a serious push into international projects. Varun Dhawan's viral mimicry of him had everyone in splits.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with dad David Dhawan is now in theaters. The family entertainer co-stars Pooja Hegde and Mrunal Thakur in classic Dhawan-style comedy of errors.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya continues her massive US concert tour, performing sold-out shows across multiple cities. The playback queen remains one of India's most beloved voices with fans worldwide.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's Main Vaapas Aaunga soundtrack with Diljit and Imtiaz Ali is out now. He also reunites with Mani Ratnam for a new film starring Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay was sworn in as Tamil Nadu Chief Minister in a historic ceremony attended by Rahul Gandhi. His final film Jananayagan is still awaiting release as he transitions fully into politics.
